PascalScript sources in this directory are the Free Pascal/Lazarus 2.2.0
maintained variant of RemObjects Pascal Script. They include upstream portability
changes and are not represented as unmodified RemObjects sources.

Origin: https://gitlab.com/freepascal.org/lazarus/lazarus/-/tree/lazarus_2_2_0/components/PascalScript/Source
Upstream: https://github.com/remobjects/pascalscript
License: pascalscript/LICENSE.md

The application registers only naming, conversion, date, and read-only functions.
The additional vendor units are compiler sources; their file-writing, DLL, GUI,
and operating-system interfaces are not registered in the application runtime.
